title: From research to intended use
lead: Glucose sensing illustrates the need ArtiSense is investigating, not an available clinical capability.
description: Potential non-invasive measurement and wearable form factors are directions that need rigorous evidence.

sections.title: A glucose example
paragraphs: Repeated measurements could be valuable where convenient monitoring matters. The supplied work, however, concerns optical feasibility and design rather than validated glucose readings from people.

sections.title: The operating context
paragraphs: An eventual device would need to account for skin and sample variability, calibration drift, environmental effects, safety, usability and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: The gap to use
paragraphs: Before any health claim, independent testing would need to establish analytical performance and the relevance of results to the intended setting. No such outcome is asserted here.
